definitions.explanation: The instinct, qualities, or sense of responsibility associated with being a father. The paternal counterpart of {母性|ぼせい} (maternal instinct). Often discussed in connection with parenting and gender roles.

examples.japanese: {父性|ふせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目覚|めざ}める→目覚める：04649_mezameru⟧。
examples.english: to awaken to one's paternal instinct

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれて→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧、{父性|ふせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: After my child was born, I came to feel my paternal instinct strongly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近年|きんねん}→近年：14349_kinnen⟧、⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かか}わる→関わる：03020_kakawaru⟧{父性|ふせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In recent years, a form of fatherhood that engages actively in child-rearing has drawn attention.

notes:
The paternal counterpart of ⟦{母性|ぼせい}→母性：15688_bosei⟧ (maternal instinct). Refers to the instincts and qualities associated with fatherhood, increasingly discussed alongside changing parenting roles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {父性|ふせい}⟦{本能|ほんのう}→本能：07623_honnou⟧: paternal instinct
- {父性|ふせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目覚|めざ}める→目覚める：04649_mezameru⟧: to awaken to fatherhood
- {父性|ふせい}{愛|あい}: paternal love

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{母性|ぼせい}→母性：15688_bosei⟧: maternal instinct — the maternal counterpart
- ⟦{父親|ちちおや}→父親：03469_chichioya⟧: father — the person, not the quality
